The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported…

items.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through O…

items.title: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.title: Server-side request forgery in Apache Jena Fuseki SHACL validation
items.summary: Apache Jena Fuseki through version 6.2.0 is affected by a server-side request forgery issue in SHACL validation. An attacker able to submit or trigger SHACL validation may cause the server to make unintended network requests.
items.mitigation: Upgrade Apache Jena Fuseki to version 6.3.0 or later. Until upgraded, restrict who can invoke SHACL validation and limit the server's outbound network access.

items.title: Authorization bypass in Bytebase DBHub MCP server
items.summary: Bytebase DBHub installations using the MCP server are affected by an authorization flaw in SQL handling. A remote attacker may bypass authentication when they can reach the MCP service and submit untrusted SQL; no prior authentication is required.
items.mitigation: Restrict MCP server network access to trusted clients and prevent untrusted users from submitting SQL through it. Monitor vendor updates and upgrade DBHub promptly when a fixed release is published.

items.title: Missing authorization in NVIDIA AIStore node-control interface
items.summary: NVIDIA AIStore storage-target node-control interfaces may permit unauthenticated access to administrative operations. An attacker who can reach a target's publicly exposed interface could access administrative functions and potentially view or alter data, or disrupt service.
items.mitigation: Remove public access to storage-target node-control interfaces and restrict them to trusted administrative networks. Apply vendor-provided updates when a fixed AIStore release is published.

items.title: Unauthenticated Python environment management in Apache Texera
items.summary: Apache Texera versions 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 can expose Python virtual-environment management interfaces without application authentication. An unauthenticated party can access those management functions when Texera runs through the local JVM or single-node Docker Compose deployment without an authentication gateway.
items.mitigation: Upgrade Apache Texera to 1.3.0-incubating. Use the Kubernetes deployment or place the affected services behind an authenticated gateway, and limit local or single-node deployments to trusted users.
